theme_decision: Dark Theme Default. A 'New Money Heritage' aesthetic using Deep Obsidian, Bone White, and Muted Gold. Financial services reimagined through the lens of a luxury editorial magazine or high-end real estate.

art_direction.description: Bold, confident, and unlike generic finance templates. No blue gradients, no cheap stock imagery. Focus on massive typography, dramatic masked reveals, raw product/material textures, and deep negative space. The brand feels established yet hyper-modern.
core_principles: Negative Space as Luxury: Let elements breathe with immense padding (p-12 to p-32).
Optical Framing: Use clipped frames and 1px subtle gold/white borders for imagery.
Tension through Typography: Massive Serifs paired with tiny, wide-tracked Monospace/Geometric Sans labels.
Motion is the Floor: Lenis momentum scrolling and Framer Motion staggered reveals are mandatory.

headings.usage: Used for the massive Hero kinetic reveal, manifesto chapter titles, and pull-quotes.

body.usage: Used for all paragraphs, UI text, and descriptions.

labels.usage: Overlines, tags, form labels, small navigational items.

rules: No full-screen gradients. Use solid dark colors with subtle grain or localized glows.
Text must meet APCA contrast ratios. Do not use pure white (#FFFFFF), use Bone White (#F3F2F0).
Buttons use the brand primary (Gold) for extreme contrast against the dark background.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use the 'Grid Borders' and 'Glassmorphism' rules. Transparent dark overlays (bg-black/60) with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl) and a 1px inner stroke (border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 or border-[#D4AF37]/20. Use for clipping images, delineating grid items, and wrapping cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle SVG noise filter overlay across the entire site to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Sharp corners or very subtle 2px radii. No heavy rounded corners to maintain the editorial/brutalist edge.

layouts.hero: Full viewport height. Content bottom-aligned or center-aligned. Massive typography. A hidden curtain/mask reveals the text as the page loads.
layouts.manifesto: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris). 12-column grid. Asymmetrical placement of text blocks and images. Numbered chapters with large typography (01, 02).
layouts.services_grid: High density grid, 1px borders between items, hover reveals.
layouts.spacing: Massive padding between sections (py-32 or py-48). Internal container padding (p-8 to p-16).

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal. Text elements start with translateY(100%) and opacity 0 inside a container with overflow-hidden, animating to translateY(0).
motion.scroll_stagger: Elements inside sections appear progressively. Use Framer Motion 'whileInView' with staggerChildren.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow, smooth drift. Editorial Ribbon style: very large outline text (text-transparent stroke-white) acting as a background texture.
motion.parallax: Subtle y-axis translation on images as users scroll past them.

components.buttons: Sharp edges, flat background. Default: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black hover:bg-[#B59A53]. Secondary: border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black. Interaction: Scale down slightly on press.
components.forms: Minimalist inputs. border-b only (flair-less), bg-transparent, floating labels or simple overlines. High contrast on focus.
components.accordion: For FAQ. Clean lines. 1px border top and bottom. Arrow rotates on open. Content animates height smoothly.

media.treatment: Images must feel like art pieces. Clip them into structural frames. Use a subtle grayscale or high-contrast filter to match the mood.

image_urls.description: Modern architecture for subtle background parallax or clipped visual interest in the hero.
Sophisticated studio portrait for the Manifesto / About section to build trust.
Golden textured background, use as a hover reveal state for service cards or accent imagery.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio for standard text. Ensure Gold on Black and Bone White on Black meet readability standards.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query. Disable parallax and heavy masks if active.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for all form inputs and the WhatsApp CTA.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Strictly use Cormorant Garamond for headings and Manrope for body text.
Install and configure '@studio-freight/react-lenis' for smooth scrolling.
Implement the 'Masked Reveal' using framer-motion: wrap text lines in overflow-hidden divs and animate the inner elements' y-axis.
Never use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids.
Do not use generic blue gradients. Stick to the luxury dark/gold palette.
Ensure the WhatsApp CTA is prominent but elegantly integrated, perhaps as a floating pill.
Build the application in React with Tailwind CSS.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with Light or Thin weights to match the luxury aesthetic.
Create a noisy grain overlay fixed to the viewport to add subtle texture.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where appropriate.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
